question:
Study the table below showing the monthly rainfall (in mm) in four cities and answer the question.

City | June | July | August | September
Delhi | 75 | 210 | 250 | 125
Mumbai | 500 | 850 | 700 | 350
Chennai | 60 | 90 | 130 | 180
Kolkata | 250 | 380 | 350 | 220

Q. What is the average rainfall recorded in Delhi across the four given months?
explanation: Total rainfall for Delhi = 75 + 210 + 250 + 125 = 660 mm. The average over 4 months = 660 / 4 = 165 mm. Options A, B, and D are incorrect arithmetic calculations of the mean.
question_hi:
नीचे दी गई तालिका का अध्ययन कीजिए जिसमें चार शहरों में मासिक वर्षा (मिमी में) दिखाई गई है और प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

शहर | जून | जुलाई | अगस्त | सितंबर
दिल्ली | 75 | 210 | 250 | 125
मुंबई | 500 | 850 | 700 | 350
चेन्नई | 60 | 90 | 130 | 180
कोलकाता | 250 | 380 | 350 | 220

प्र. दिए गए चार महीनों में दिल्ली में दर्ज की गई औसत वर्षा कितनी है?
explanation_hi: दिल्ली के लिए कुल वर्षा = 75 + 210 + 250 + 125 = 660 मिमी। 4 महीनों का औसत = 660 / 4 = 165 मिमी। विकल्प A, B और D माध्य की गलत गणितीय गणनाएँ हैं।

question:
Study the table below showing the number of cars sold by five companies over four years and answer the question.

Company | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Alpha | 1200 | 1400 | 1600 | 2000
Beta | 800 | 900 | 1100 | 1500
Gamma | 1500 | 1300 | 1400 | 1600
Delta | 600 | 700 | 800 | 900
Omega | 2000 | 2200 | 2500 | 2800

explanation: Total sales for Omega = 2000 + 2200 + 2500 + 2800 = 9500. Average = 9500 / 4 = 2375. Options B, C, and D are incorrect calculations.

question:
Study the table below showing research papers published by five institutions over four years and answer the question.

Institution | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Inst-A | 150 | 180 | 210 | 260
Inst-B | 90 | 110 | 130 | 170
Inst-C | 300 | 290 | 310 | 340
Inst-D | 200 | 220 | 250 | 300
Inst-E | 120 | 150 | 190 | 240

Q. Which institution showed the highest absolute increase in paper publications from 2020 to 2023?
explanation: Absolute increase from 2020 to 2023: Inst-A = 260 - 150 = 110; Inst-B = 170 - 90 = 80; Inst-C = 340 - 300 = 40; Inst-D = 300 - 200 = 100; Inst-E = 240 - 120 = 120. Inst-E has the highest absolute increase of 120. Options A, B, and D have lower absolute gains.
explanation_hi: 2020 से 2023 तक निरपेक्ष वृद्धि: संस्थान-A = 110; संस्थान-B = 80; संस्थान-C = 40; संस्थान-D = 100; संस्थान-E = 240 - 120 = 120। संस्थान-E की वृद्धि 120 है जो सबसे अधिक है। विकल्प A, B और D की पूर्ण वृद्धि कम है।

question:
Study the table showing tickets sold by a cinema on seven days and answer the question.

Day | Morning Show | Afternoon Show | Evening Show | Night Show
Monday | 120 | 180 | 300 | 400
Tuesday | 100 | 150 | 250 | 350
Wednesday | 110 | 160 | 280 | 380
Thursday | 130 | 170 | 290 | 390
Friday | 200 | 300 | 550 | 700
Saturday | 350 | 500 | 800 | 950
Sunday | 400 | 550 | 850 | 1000

Q. On which day was the total ticket sales across all four shows the highest?
explanation: Total sales by day: Mon = 1000, Tue = 850, Wed = 930, Thu = 980, Fri = 1750, Sat = 2600, Sun = 2800. Sunday has the highest total ticket sales of 2800. Option B is incorrect because Saturday's total is 2600, which is lower than Sunday.
explanation_hi: दिन के अनुसार कुल बिक्री: सोम = 1000, मंगल = 850, बुध = 930, गुरु = 980, शुक्र = 1750, शनि = 2600, रवि = 2800। रविवार को कुल टिकट बिक्री सबसे अधिक 2800 है। विकल्प B गलत है क्योंकि शनिवार की कुल बिक्री 2600 है, जो रविवार से कम है।

question:
Study the table showing deposits and loans of a bank over five years (in crores of rupees) and answer the question.

Year | Savings Deposits | Fixed Deposits | Current Deposits | Agricultural Loans | Industrial Loans | Personal Loans
2019 | 450 | 1200 | 300 | 500 | 800 | 400
2020 | 500 | 1350 | 350 | 550 | 850 | 450
2021 | 600 | 1500 | 400 | 600 | 900 | 500
2022 | 750 | 1800 | 500 | 750 | 1200 | 600
2023 | 900 | 2100 | 600 | 900 | 1250 | 800

Q. What is the average of Personal Loans across the five years?
explanation: Personal Loans for the five years: 400, 450, 500, 600, 800. Sum = 400 + 450 + 500 + 600 + 800 = 2750. Average = 2750 / 5 = 550 crores. Option B is incorrect as it overestimates the sum by miscalculating the 2023 value.

question:
Study the table below showing the number of Internet Users by Age Group (in thousands) across three years and answer the question.

Year | 15-24 Years | 25-44 Years | 45-60 Years | Above 60 Years
2021 | 120 | 180 | 90 | 30
2022 | 150 | 210 | 120 | 40
2023 | 200 | 280 | 150 | 70

Q. Which age group registered the highest absolute growth in number of users from 2021 to 2023?
explanation: Absolute growth for 15-24 years = 200 - 120 = 80. For 25-44 years = 280 - 180 = 100. For 45-60 years = 150 - 90 = 60. For Above 60 years = 70 - 30 = 40. Thus, '25-44 Years' has the highest absolute growth of 100 thousand, making option B correct.
question_hi:
नीचे दी गई तालिका का अध्ययन करें और प्रश्न का उत्तर दें।

वर्ष | 15-24 वर्ष | 25-44 वर्ष | 45-60 वर्ष | 60 वर्ष से ऊपर
2021 | 120 | 180 | 90 | 30
2022 | 150 | 210 | 120 | 40
2023 | 200 | 280 | 150 | 70

प्र. 2021 से 2023 तक उपयोगकर्ताओं की संख्या में किस आयु वर्ग में सबसे अधिक निरपेक्ष वृद्धि दर्ज की गई?
explanation_hi: 15-24 वर्ष के लिए वृद्धि = 80, 25-44 वर्ष के लिए वृद्धि = 100, 45-60 वर्ष के लिए वृद्धि = 60, और 60 वर्ष से ऊपर के लिए वृद्धि = 40 है। इसलिए, '25-44 वर्ष' में सबसे अधिक वृद्धि (100) हुई।

question:
Study the table below showing the number of Internet Users by Age Group (in thousands) across three years and answer the question.

Year | 15-24 Years | 25-44 Years | 45-60 Years | Above 60 Years
2021 | 120 | 180 | 90 | 30
2022 | 150 | 210 | 120 | 40
2023 | 200 | 280 | 150 | 70

Q. What is the average number of internet users per year in the '45-60 Years' age group over the given three-year period?
explanation: The number of users in '45-60 Years' age group for 2021, 2022, and 2023 are 90, 120, and 150 respectively. Sum = 90 + 120 + 150 = 360. Average = 360 / 3 = 120 thousand. Option A is correct.

explanation_hi: '45-60 वर्ष' आयु वर्ग के लिए उपयोगकर्ताओं की संख्या 90, 120 और 150 है। योग = 360, औसत = 360 / 3 = 120 हजार। विकल्प A सही है।
